symptoms.ta: No-start சாத்தியம் (low side circuit ground-க்கு short ஆனா DTC set ஆகாம stall/no-start வரலாம்)

steps.ta: STEP 1: Diagnostic System Check - Engine Controls perform பண்ணீங்களா? இல்லைனா முதலில் அதை பண்ணுங்க
STEP 2: Scan tool install பண்ணுங்க → ignition 30 நொடி OFF → ignition ON (engine OFF) → scan tool-ல் DTC info monitor பண்ணுங்க. இந்த ignition cycle-ல் DTC fail ஆகுதா பாருங்க
STEP 3: Scan tool-ல் FRP Regulator Feedback Current parameter பாருங்க — 300 mA-க்கு குறைவா இருக்கானு check பண்ணுங்க
STEP 4: Step 3-ல் value 900mA-க்கு குறைவா இருக்கானு recheck பண்ணுங்க

STEP 5: Ignition OFF → FRP regulator harness connector disconnect பண்ணுங்க → high side circuit (E17 connector pin 1) மற்றும் known good ground இடையே test lamp connect பண்ணுங்க → ignition ON (engine OFF) → lamp illuminate ஆகுதான்னு பாருங்க

repair.ta: Root cause confirm ஆனதும் — FRP regulator harness repair, connector clean/repair, அல்லது FRP regulator replace பண்ணுங்க. Code clear பண்ணி test drive பண்ணி confirm பண்ணுங்க.

extra.circuit_description: FRP (Fuel Rail Pressure) regulator fuel supply pump-ல் install ஆகி இருக்கும், rail-க்குள் போகும் suction fuel quantity-ஐ control பண்ணும். Normal state-ல் fully open-ஆ இருக்கும் — drive current அதிகமா இருந்தா opening சிறுசா ஆகும். ECM desired fuel rail pressure மற்றும் fuel flow rate-ஐ calculate பண்ணி, actual value-உடன் compare பண்ணி FRP regulator position தீர்மானிக்கும். ECM FRP regulator solenoid feedback current-ஐ excessively low அல்லது high-ஆ detect பண்ணா, P0091 அல்லது P0092 set ஆகும்.
extra.sets_when: ECM FRP regulator feedback current 50 mA-க்கு குறைவா, அல்லது desired current-ஐ விட 1000 mA-க்கு குறைவா இருக்கிறதா detect பண்ணா P0091 set ஆகும்

symptoms.si: පණ නොගැන්වීමට ඉඩ ඇත (ඉහළ පැත්තේ පරිපථය වෝල්ටීයතාවයට short වුවහොත් එන්ජිම නැවතී නැවත පණ නොගැන්වේ)

causes.si: FRP නියාමක හාර්නස් විවෘත / short වීම

steps.ta: STEP 1: Diagnostic System Check - Engine Controls முதலில் perform பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 1: First perform the Diagnostic System Check – Engine Controls.
steps.si: පියවර 1: මුලින්ම Diagnostic System Check – Engine Controls සිදු කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 2: Scan tool install பண்ணுங்க → Ignition 30 நொடி OFF → Ignition ON (engine OFF) → scan tool-ல் DTC info monitor பண்ணுங்க. இந்த ignition cycle-ல் DTC fail ஆகுதான்னு பாருங்க.
steps.en: STEP 2: Install the scan tool → Ignition OFF for 30 seconds → Ignition ON (engine OFF) → monitor the DTC info on the scan tool. Check whether the DTC fails in this ignition cycle.
steps.si: පියවර 2: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එක සවි කරන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් තත්පර 30ක් OFF කරන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් ON කරන්න (එන්ජිම OFF) → ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ DTC තොරතුරු නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න. මෙම ඉග්නිෂන් චක්‍රයේදී DTC අසාර්ථක වේදැයි බලන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 3: Scan tool-ல் FRP Regulator Feedback Current parameter பாருங்க — 300 mA-க்கு மேல இருக்கானு check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 3: On the scan tool, check the FRP Regulator Feedback Current parameter — see whether it is above 300 mA.
steps.si: පියවර 3: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ FRP Regulator Feedback Current පරාමිතිය බලන්න — එය 300 mA ට වඩා වැඩිද යන්න පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 4: Step 3-ல் value 900mA-க்கு மேல இருக்கானு recheck பண்ணுங்க (P0092 confirm ஆகும்).
steps.en: STEP 4: Re-check whether the Step 3 value is above 900 mA (this confirms P0092).
steps.si: පියවර 4: පියවර 3 හි අගය 900 mA ට වඩා වැඩිදැයි නැවත පරීක්ෂා කරන්න (P0092 තහවුරු වේ).

steps.ta: STEP 5: Ignition OFF → FRP regulator harness connector (E17) disconnect பண்ணுங்க → high side circuit (E17 connector pin 1) மற்றும் known good ground இடையே test lamp connect பண்ணுங்க → Ignition ON (engine OFF) → lamp illuminate ஆகுதான்னு பாருங்க. Illuminate ஆனா **Step 6**-க்கு போங்க, இல்லைனா **Step 9**-க்கு போங்க.
steps.en: STEP 5: Ignition OFF → disconnect the FRP regulator harness connector (E17) → connect a test lamp between the high-side circuit (E17 pin 1) and a known good ground → Ignition ON (engine OFF) → see whether the lamp lights. If it lights, go to **Step 6**; if not, go to **Step 9**.
steps.si: පියවර 5: ඉග්නිෂන් OFF → FRP නියාමක හාර්නස් සම්බන්ධකය (E17) ගලවන්න → ඉහළ පැත්තේ පරිපථය (E17 pin 1) සහ හොඳ බව දන්නා භූගතයක් (ground) අතර test lamp එකක් සම්බන්ධ කරන්න → ඉග්නිෂන් ON (එන්ජිම OFF) → ලාම්පුව දැල්වේදැයි බලන්න. දැල්වුණහොත් **පියවර 6** වෙත, නැතිනම් **පියවර 9** වෙත යන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 6: (Lamp Illuminated - High side power சரி) → FRP regulator low side circuit (E17 connector pin 2) – known good ground-க்கு short ஆகி இருக்கானு DMM (Digital Multimeter) வெச்சு Continuity check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 6: (Lamp lit – high-side power OK) → use a DMM to check continuity of the FRP regulator low-side circuit (E17 pin 2) for a short to known good ground.
steps.si: පියවර 6: (ලාම්පුව දැල්වුණා – ඉහළ පැත්තේ බලය හරි) → FRP නියාමක පහළ පැත්තේ පරිපථය (E17 pin 2) හොඳ භූගතයට short වී ඇත්දැයි DMM එකකින් continuity පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 7: Step 6-ல் short இருந்தால் harness repair பண்ணுங்க. Short இல்லைனால், FRP Regulator (SCV) coil-க்குள் internal short fault ஆகும் – FRP Regulator-ஐ replace பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 7: If Step 6 shows a short, repair the harness. If there is no short, the FRP regulator (SCV) coil has an internal short — replace the FRP regulator.
steps.si: පියවර 7: පියවර 6 හි short එකක් තිබුණහොත් හාර්නස් එක අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න. short එකක් නැතිනම්, FRP නියාමක (SCV) දඟරය තුළ අභ්‍යන්තර short එකකි — FRP නියාමකය මාරු කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 8: DTC clear பண்ணி, Ignition cycle 2 முறை run பண்ணி (warm-up) DTC return ஆகுதான்னு பாருங்க. Return ஆனால் ECM-க்குள் இருக்கும் internal driver circuit fault – ECM replace பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 8: Clear the DTC, run 2 ignition cycles (warm-up) and see whether the DTC returns. If it returns, there is an internal driver circuit fault in the ECM — replace the ECM.
steps.si: පියවර 8: DTC මකා, ඉග්නිෂන් චක්‍ර 2ක් (warm-up) ධාවනය කර DTC නැවත එන්නේදැයි බලන්න. නැවත ආවොත් ECM තුළ අභ්‍යන්තර driver පරිපථ දෝෂයකි — ECM මාරු කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 9: (Lamp NOT Illuminated - High side power இல்ல) → FRP regulator high side circuit (E17 pin 1)-ல் Battery voltage feed வருதான்னு check பண்ணுங்க. ECM main relay (pin 21/40) மற்றும் அதற்கான fuse-ஐ check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 9: (Lamp not lit – no high-side power) → check that battery voltage is reaching the FRP regulator high-side circuit (E17 pin 1). Check the ECM main relay (pins 21/40) and its fuse.
steps.si: පියවර 9: (ලාම්පුව නොදැල්වුණා – ඉහළ පැත්තේ බලය නැත) → FRP නියාමක ඉහළ පැත්තේ පරිපථයට (E17 pin 1) බැටරි වෝල්ටීයතාව පැමිණෙන්නේදැයි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න. ECM main relay (pin 21/40) සහ එහි fuse එක පරීක්ෂා කරන්න.

steps.ta: STEP 10: Step 9-ல் high side circuit-ல் open/short இருந்தால் wiring repair பண்ணுங்க. Wiring சரியாக இருந்தும் voltage வரலைனால், ECM-க்குள் high side driver fault ஆகும் – ECM replace பண்ணுங்க.
steps.en: STEP 10: If Step 9 finds an open/short in the high-side circuit, repair the wiring. If the wiring is fine but there is still no voltage, the ECM high-side driver is faulty — replace the ECM.
steps.si: පියවර 10: පියවර 9 හි ඉහළ පැත්තේ පරිපථයේ විවෘත/short එකක් හමුවුවහොත් රැහැන් අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න. රැහැන් හරි වුවත් වෝල්ටීයතාව නොපැමිණෙන්නේ නම්, ECM ඉහළ පැත්තේ driver එක දෝෂ සහිතය — ECM මාරු කරන්න.

repair.ta: Root cause confirm ஆனதும் — FRP regulator harness repair, connector clean/repair, அல்லது FRP regulator replace பண்ணுங்க. Code clear பண்ணி test drive பண்ணி confirm பண்ணுங்க.
repair.en: Once the root cause is confirmed — repair the FRP regulator harness, clean/repair the connector, or replace the FRP regulator. Clear the code and confirm with a test drive.
repair.si: මූලික හේතුව තහවුරු වූ පසු — FRP නියාමක හාර්නස් අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න, සම්බන්ධකය පිරිසිදු/අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න, හෝ FRP නියාමකය මාරු කරන්න. කේතය මකා පරීක්ෂණ ධාවනයකින් තහවුරු කරන්න.

source: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual — Section 1A-80, Engine Control System, page 83 (DTC P0091 or P0092)

extra.circuit_description: FRP (Fuel Rail Pressure) regulator fuel supply pump-ல் install ஆகி இருக்கும், rail-க்குள் போகும் suction fuel quantity-ஐ control பண்ணும். Normal state-ல் fully open-ஆ இருக்கும் — drive current அதிகமா இருந்தா opening சிறுசா ஆகும். ECM desired fuel rail pressure மற்றும் fuel flow rate-ஐ calculate பண்ணி, actual value-உடன் compare பண்ணி FRP regulator position தீர்மானிக்கும். ECM FRP regulator solenoid feedback current-ஐ excessively low அல்லது high-ஆ detect பண்ணா, P0091 அல்லது P0092 set ஆகும்.
extra.sets_when: ECM FRP regulator feedback current 2400 mA-க்கு மேல், அல்லது desired current-ஐ விட 1000 mA-க்கு மேல் இருக்கிறதா detect பண்ணா P0092 set ஆகும்
ecm_action: ECM fuel injection quantity limit பண்ணும்
extra.diagnostic_aid: Intermittent fault சந்தேகப்பட்டா, Intermittent Conditions section பாருங்க. Connector: E17 (Engine Controls connector end view reference)
extra.clearing_condition: Type A DTC clearing definitions படி — 3 consecutive trips-ல் fault நடக்காம இருந்தா clear ஆகும் (standard Type A pattern)
extra.location: Fuel Rail Pressure Regulator (SCV) — Fuel supply pump (Connector E17)
extra.wiring:
Connector: E17
Pin 1 (WHT/RED): High side (PWM control)
Pin 2 (GRN/RED): Low side (feedback)

Reference: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual Section 1A-28

circuit_description: The FRP (Fuel Rail Pressure) regulator is installed on the fuel supply pump and controls the quantity of suction fuel going into the rail. In its normal state it is fully open — the higher the drive current, the smaller the opening. The ECM calculates the desired fuel rail pressure and fuel flow rate, compares them with the actual values, and determines the FRP regulator position. If the ECM detects the FRP regulator solenoid feedback current as excessively low or high, P0091 or P0092 is set.

FRP (Fuel Rail Pressure) නියාමකය ඉන්ධන සැපයුම් පොම්පයේ සවි කර ඇති අතර රේල් එකට යන suction ඉන්ධන ප්‍රමාණය පාලනය කරයි. සාමාන්‍ය තත්ත්වයේදී එය සම්පූර්ණයෙන් විවෘතව පවතී — ධාවන ධාරාව වැඩි වන තරමට විවරය කුඩා වේ. ECM එක අපේක්ෂිත ඉන්ධන රේල් පීඩනය සහ ඉන්ධන ප්‍රවාහ අනුපාතය ගණනය කර, සත්‍ය අගයන් සමඟ සසඳා FRP නියාමකයේ ස්ථානය තීරණය කරයි. ECM එක FRP නියාමක සොලිනොයිඩ් ප්‍රතිපෝෂණ ධාරාව අධික ලෙස අඩු හෝ ඉහළ බව හඳුනාගත්තොත් P0091 හෝ P0092 සකස් වේ.
running_condition: DTC P060B must not be set
DTC P060B සකස් වී නොතිබිය යුතුය
Battery voltage must be between 18 and 32 volts
බැටරි වෝල්ටීයතාව වෝල්ට් 18 – 32 අතර විය යුතුය

title.en: Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected

symptoms.ta: MIL flashing (severe misfire, catalyst damage risk) அல்லது steady ON

causes.ta: Fuel delivery பிரச்சனை (low fuel pressure, injector clog — multiple cylinders affect ஆகும்)

causes.en: Low compression (timing chain stretch, valve issue)

causes.ta: Valvematic actuator fault (P2646/P265B group) இருந்தா அதுவும் misfire-ஐ trigger பண்ணலாம்

steps.ta: Freeze frame data பாத்து எந்த conditions-ல் misfire வருதுனு பாருங்க
Spark plugs remove பண்ணி inspect பண்ணுங்க (fouling, wear, gap)
Ignition coils swap test பண்ணுங்க (misfire cylinder மாறுதுன்னா coil fault)
Fuel trims (Short/Long term) live data-ல் பாருங்க — lean/rich indicate பண்ணுமா
Valvematic DTCs (P2646/P265B/P10A0/P1055) set ஆகி இருக்கானு check பண்ணுங்க

repair.ta: Root cause confirm ஆனதுக்கு ஏத்தாற்போல் — spark plugs/coils replace பண்ணுங்க, fuel system check பண்ணுங்க, vacuum leak repair பண்ணுங்க. Multiple misfires with catalyst risk-ஆ இருந்தா உடனே drive பண்ணாம diagnose பண்ணுங்க (MIL flashing = catalyst damage risk).

note: Universal OBD-II code — petrol engines-க்கு பொருந்தும் (Toyota 3ZR-FAE/2ZR-FAE உட்பட)

steps.ta: Ignition ON engine OFF — scan tool-ல் EGR position sensor voltage (Pin 92/93/94) monitor பண்ணுங்க. 0.5V-க்கு கீழ இருந்தா ground short சந்தேகிக்கலாம்
steps.en: Ignition ON, engine OFF — monitor the EGR position sensor voltage (pins 92/93/94) on the scan tool. If it is below 0.5 V, suspect a short to ground
steps.si: ඉග්නිෂන් ON, එන්ජිම OFF — ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ EGR ස්ථාන සංවේදක වෝල්ටීයතාව (pin 92/93/94) නිරීක්ෂණය කරන්න. 0.5V ට අඩු නම් භූගතයට short වීමක් සැක කරන්න

steps.en: Check that the 5V reference (pin 87, LT GRN) is present
steps.si: 5V යොමුව (pin 87, LT GRN) පවතින්නේදැයි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න

steps.ta: Connector pins-ல் corrosion/bent pin check பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: Check the connector pins for corrosion/bent pins
steps.si: සම්බන්ධක pin විඛාදනය/නැමුණු pin සඳහා පරීක්ෂා කරන්න

repair.ta: Wiring short confirm ஆனா repair பண்ணுங்க. Sensor fault confirm ஆனா EGR valve assembly replace பண்ணுங்க (position sensor தனியா replace பண்ண முடியாது — assembly-ஆவே மாற்ற வேண்டும்).
repair.en: If a wiring short is confirmed, repair it. If a sensor fault is confirmed, replace the EGR valve assembly (the position sensor cannot be replaced separately — the whole assembly must be replaced).
repair.si: රැහැන් short එකක් තහවුරු වුවහොත් අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න. සංවේදක දෝෂයක් තහවුරු වුවහොත් EGR කපාට එකලස්කිරීම (assembly) මාරු කරන්න (ස්ථාන සංවේදකය වෙනම මාරු කළ නොහැක — සම්පූර්ණ assembly එකම මාරු කළ යුතුය).

causes.si: EGR ස්ථාන සංවේදක සංඥා රැහැන වෝල්ටීයතාවයට short වී ඇත

causes.ta: Connector-ல் signal மற்றும் 5V reference wire touch ஆகி இருக்கலாம்
causes.en: The signal and 5V reference wires may be touching at the connector
causes.si: සම්බන්ධකයේ සංඥා රැහැන සහ 5V යොමු රැහැන ස්පර්ශ වී තිබිය හැක

steps.ta: Scan tool-ல் EGR position sensor voltage 4.9V-க்கு மேல stuck-ஆ இருக்கானு check பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: Check on the scan tool whether the EGR position sensor voltage is stuck above 4.9 V
steps.si: ස්කෑන් ටූල් එකේ EGR ස්ථාන සංවේදක වෝල්ටීයතාව 4.9V ට වැඩියෙන් සිරවී ඇත්දැයි පරීක්ෂා කරන්න

steps.ta: Signal wire-ஐ 5V reference wire-உடன் short ஆகி இருக்கானு visual/continuity check பண்ணுங்க
steps.en: Visually / with a continuity check, see whether the signal wire is shorted to the 5V reference wire
steps.si: සංඥා රැහැන 5V යොමු රැහැනට short වී ඇත්දැයි දෘශ්‍යමාන/continuity පරීක්ෂාවෙන් බලන්න

steps.ta: Connector pins bent/touching இருக்கானு பாருங்க
steps.en: Check whether the connector pins are bent/touching
steps.si: සම්බන්ධක pin නැමී/ස්පර්ශ වී ඇත්දැයි බලන්න

repair.ta: Wiring short confirm ஆனா repair பண்ணுங்க. Sensor fault confirm ஆனா EGR valve assembly replace பண்ணுங்க.
repair.en: If a wiring short is confirmed, repair it. If a sensor fault is confirmed, replace the EGR valve assembly.
repair.si: රැහැන් short එකක් තහවුරු වුවහොත් අලුත්වැඩියා කරන්න. සංවේදක දෝෂයක් තහවුරු වුවහොත් EGR කපාට එකලස්කිරීම මාරු කරන්න.

title.en: Immobilizer Security Information Not Programmed

symptoms.ta: No-start — engine crank ஆகும், ஆனா start ஆகாது (immobilizer fuel injection-ஐ block பண்ணுடும்)
Starter cut relay energize ஆகி, சில நேரம் cranking-ஏ நடக்காம போகலாம்
SVS lamp ON ஆகும் (Euro 4 spec) அல்லது MIL ON ஆகும் (Except Euro 4 spec)
Scan tool-ல் 'Immobilizer Function Programmed' parameter = No-ன்னு காட்டும்

causes.ta: Puthusa போட்ட replacement ECM immobilizer program பண்ணப்படாம இருக்கிறது (மிகவும் common காரணம்)
Key/immobilizer security information ECM-ல் program ஆகாம இருக்கிறது
ECM reset ஆகி/adjustment value clear ஆகி immobilizer data இழந்திருக்கலாம்
ICU (Immobilizer Control Unit) fault அல்லது ECM-ICU CAN communication issue (இதனால P0633 உடன் U0167/U0001 சேர்ந்து fail ஆகலாம்)

steps.ta: STEP 1: Diagnostic System Check - Engine Controls perform பண்ணீங்களா? இல்லைனா முதலில் அதை பண்ணுங்க
STEP 2: Scan tool install பண்ணுங்க → ignition 30 நொடி OFF → ignition ON (engine OFF) → DTC information monitor பண்ணுங்க. P0633 உடன் U0001 அல்லது U0167-யும் set ஆகி இருக்கானு பாருங்க
STEP 3: Immobilizer DTCs (B அல்லது U code-ஆ ஆரம்பிக்கும்) இந்த ignition cycle-ல் fail ஆகுதானு scan tool-ல் monitor பண்ணுங்க — fail ஆனா Immobilizer section-ல் applicable DTC-க்கே போங்க
STEP 4: மேல steps-ல் root cause கிடைக்கலைனா — ECM-க்குள் immobilizer security information-ஐ program பண்ணுங்க (Resetting and Programming Guidelines, Immobilizer section — Section 9I Security and Lock)
STEP 5: புதிய/replacement ECM-ஆ இருந்தா — ECM-ஐ program பண்ணி learn பண்ணணும் (Important: Replacement ECM must be programmed and learned)
STEP 6: DTCs clear பண்ணுங்க → ignition 30 நொடி OFF → ignition ON (engine OFF) → engine start பண்ண try பண்ணி confirm பண்ணுங்க

repair.ta:
Scan tool (Tech 2 அல்லது TIS 2000 PC + hardware key) வெச்சு immobilizer security information-ஐ ECM-க்குள் program பண்ணுங்க (Resetting and Programming Guidelines). Replacement ECM போட்டிருந்தா — VIN program பண்ணி, fuel injector ID codes உள்ளிட்டு, immobilizer தகவலையும் program பண்ணி learn பண்ணி முடிக்கணும் (இது இல்லாம engine start ஆகவே ஆகாது). TIS 2000-ல்: Diagnostics → Vehicle → Engine Model → Programming → Program ECU → VIN சரிபார்த்து → Fuel Injector ID Codes → Immobilizer info program பண்ணுங்க. Program பண்ணின பிறகு DTC clear பண்ணி, ignition 30 நொடி OFF பண்ணி, engine start பண்ணி confirm பண்ணுங்க.

Scan tool இல்லாம DTC clear பண்ண (Euro 4 அல்லாத spec-க்கு மட்டும்): Ignition ON (engine OFF) → DLC Pin 12 (Diagnostic Request)-ஐ Pin 4 (Ground)-உடன் jump பண்ணி, accelerator pedal-ஐ 1-3 நொடி இடைவெளியில் press-release-press-release-press-release (மொத்தம் 3 தடவை) பண்ணுங்க. ⚠ இது ஒரு manual fallback method — முடிந்தவரை scan tool வெச்சே clear பண்ணுங்க, இது accurate-ஆ இருக்கும்.

source: Isuzu 4JJ1 Service Manual — Section 1A-198/199, Engine Control System

extra.circuit_description: ECM-ல் இருக்கிற EEPROM (Electronically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory)-ல் immobilizer security information memorize பண்ணி வெச்சிருக்கும் — இதை வெச்சுதான் ICU (Immobilizer Control Unit)-உடன் communicate பண்ணி engine start-ஐ enable பண்ணும். இந்த security information ECM-ல் program ஆகாம இருந்தா, ECM இதை detect பண்ணி P0633 DTC set பண்ணும். ⚠ Immobilizer system active-ஆ இருந்து இது போன்ற fault இருந்தா, ECM fuel injection-ஐ disable பண்ணிடும் — engine crank ஆகும், ஆனா start ஆகிற உடனேயே stall ஆகிடும் (அல்லது Starter Cut Relay-ஐ energize பண்ணி cranking-ஐயே disable பண்ணிடும்).
extra.sets_when: ECM, immobilizer security information program ஆகாம இருக்கிறதுனு detect பண்ணும் போது இந்த DTC set ஆகும். இது பொதுவா non-programmed replacement ECM போட்டப்போ வரும்.
ecm_action: SVS lamp illuminate ஆகும் — Type C (Euro 4 specification)
MIL illuminate ஆகும் — Type A (Except Euro 4 specification)
Immobilizer active-ஆ இருந்தா fuel injection disable பண்ணி, starter cut relay energize பண்ணி cranking disable பண்ணலாம்
extra.diagnostic_aid: இந்த DTC-ஐ diagnose பண்ணும் முன்ன Diagnostic System Check - Engine Controls compulsory-ஆ முடிக்கணும். P0633 உடன் U0001 அல்லது U0167 DTC-யும் set ஆகி இருக்கானு scan tool-ல் check பண்ணுங்க — அப்படி இருந்தா முதலில் அந்த immobilizer communication DTC-ஐ diagnose பண்ணுங்க (Section 9I Security and Lock). Non-programmed replacement ECM தான் field-ல் மிகவும் அதிகமா காணப்படும் காரணம். ஸ்கேன் டூல்-ஏ communicate ஆகலைனா, immobilizer program பண்ண முன்னாடி — ECM power/ground (J13/J14 connectors, pins 22/24/62/68/81), ECM main relay (X18), ECM fuses (30A slow blow, main 10A), மற்றும் CAN bus resistance (DLC Pin 6 & 14 இடையே 50–70Ω) ஆகியவற்றை முதலில் rule-out பண்ணுங்க — இவை சரியில்லைனா ECM/ICU communicate ஆகவே ஆகாது.
extra.location: Immobilizer Control Unit (ICU) — connector B-109 வழியா ECM-உடன் CAN bus (shared circuit) மூலம் communicate பண்ணும். ICU பொதுவா steering column/ignition switch பகுதியில் mount ஆகி இருக்கும் (exact position model/body electrical section-ல் வேறுபடலாம்).
extra.wiring:
Dedicated pin-out இந்த DTC-க்கு தனியா இல்ல — ECM ↔ ICU shared CAN bus circuit வழியா communicate பண்ணும் (DLC connector B-58, pins 6 & 14 — CAN High/Low). ICU harness connector: B-109.

CAN Bus Circuit:
CAN High: DLC Pin 6 — ECM Pin 58 (J14) — ICU Pin 6 — CAN resistor Pin 1
CAN Low: DLC Pin 14 — ECM Pin 78 (J14) — ICU Pin 5 — CAN resistor Pin 2
Resistance spec (DLC Pin 6 & 14 இடையே, ignition OFF): 50–70Ω (ECM 120Ω + IP cluster/ICU 120Ω parallel)

ECM Power/Ground (பொதுவான no-start check — immobilizer active-ஆ இருந்தா முதலில் இதுங்களை rule-out பண்ணுங்க):
Battery voltage: 18–32V (24V system)
ECM ground: connectors J13, J14 — Pins 22, 24, 62, 68, 81
ECM main relay: X18
Fuses: ECM (30A) slow blow, ECM main (10A), ECM (10A)
